title: Elementary organometallic reactions
basic_overview: Oxidative addition, reductive elimination, insertion and β-hydride elimination are core organometallic steps.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Track OS/e count. 2. For OA add R and X. 3. For RE couple ligands. 4. For insertion add substrate into M–R/M–H. 5. For β-H eliminate alkene + M–H.
extra_info_content.factors: Actual catalytic cycles depend on ligand set, geometry and substrate.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
